description: F-104G Starfighter delivered to the Luftwaffe in 1964 that flew only about 8 hours before becoming a ground instructional airframe; restored over more than 2000 volunteer hours and moved into the main hangar at Rheine-Bentlage on 26 May 2023.

F-104G Starfighter, c/n 7140, wearing the early Luftwaffe code DF+101; long the gate guardian of the Rheine-Bentlage airfield and returned to display in April 2022 after restoration. The International F-104 Society reports it kept in the same shelter as 25+86, so its exact standing position should be checked on site.
Complete cockpit section of an F-4F Phantom II, the type flown by Jagdgeschwader 72 Westfalen and by the F-4F training centre at Hopsten. Serial not established from the sources consulted.
